asset.name: SplitPaneWorkspace
asset.description: The multi-region workspace with resizing, collapse, persistence, keyboard controls, responsive stacking, and an independent loading and error boundary for each region.

requires.reason: Region layout, resizing, and responsive stacking are shared.
Every generic state is delegated to the shared boundary rather than reimplemented per workflow.

rationale: What it adds over navigation.split-view is per-region failure isolation: one pane failing to load must not blank the others, which is the difference between a layout and a workspace.
